name: ANZA — Australian & New Zealand Association
summary: Community association for Aussies, Kiwis, and friends — sports, socials, and family programming that accelerates belonging without country-club fees.
body: ANZA functions as a community operating system rather than a facilities club: sports teams, social events, and family programming help new arrivals find people in weeks instead of months. Forum advice for ANZ families — and many trailing partners — often ranks association membership above expensive country-club entrance fees for year-one ROI. Use recurring sport or social groups as network infrastructure while a Dependant’s Pass job search runs. Check current membership categories, event calendars, and whether friends-of-ANZ can attend before budgeting. Complements hashes, Meetup hobbies, school-parent networks, and AWA-style women’s associations.
membershipNotes: Annual membership — typically far lighter than country-club entrance fees. Verify live dues and guest policies for events.
